items.title: Joe LaBarbera interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 15, 2021
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah. Right. Imagine trying to fall back with like Billie Holiday or something.

ctx.x: You might have a valid point there, Monk. I haven’t really thought about that too much. I mean I know musicians, like a Joe Lovano for example. Joe plays with the time in a way that makes it very very very fun to play along with. He’ll sit back on the time, you know, he’s not trying to like put it in a metric grid. He’s playing around with the time and you know if you need a comparison for this, the way Basie’s band sits back on the beat, right? So Bud Shank played like that. I played a lot with Bud Shank. He…
Yeah. Right. Imagine trying to fall back with like Billie Holiday or something.
You know believe it or not the person who threw people the most and was probably the most rhythmically hip was Anita O’Day. I’ve never heard anybody that could back- © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
